items.title: Canadian crude discount with U.S. at widest level since 2018
items.summary: Investing.com -- Canadian heavy crude prices fell to their weakest level relative to US oil futures since 2018, when a pipeline bottleneck led Alberta's government to impose production limits on major producers.

items.summary: Most retirees watch dividend income pile up in some months and vanish in others, but three stocks with staggered payment schedules can close that gap in a way most income portfolios never consider.

items.title: Can PG's Premium Brands Hold Up in a Value-Seeking Market?
items.summary: P&G's premium brands benefit from innovation and strong loyalty, but rising costs and value-conscious consumers pose challenges to sustaining growth.

items.title: TSX futures drop amid rise in oil prices; U.S. midterm elections ahead
items.summary: Investing.com - Futures connected to Canada’s main stock index pointed lower on Tuesday, as investors assessed a renewed jump in oil prices and looked ahead to the U.S. midterm elections.

items.title: Apple, Palantir report; U.S. midterm elections ahead - what’s moving markets
items.summary: Investing.com - Futures linked to the main U.S. stock indices are subdued, as investors assessed a fresh batch of technology sector earnings and looked ahead to the much-anticipated American midterm elections. Apple and Palantir shares dip in extended hours trading after the two companies’ latest quarterly reports, while artificial intelligence and affordability are likely to be key issues for American voters.

items.title: Oil turns lower after Trump says he will halt $4 billion in funding to Israel
items.summary: Investing.com - Oil prices edged lower Tuesday after U.S. President Donald Trump said he would cut off $4 billion in aid to Israel by the end of the year.

items.title: Gold choppy as oil prices edge lower, U.S. midterms loom large
items.summary: Investing.com - Gold prices were volatile on Tuesday, as oil prices turned lower and investors looked ahead to the critical U.S. midterm elections.

items.title: CL Q3 deep dive: global demand and premium innovation support steady growth amid cost pressures
items.summary: Consumer products company Colgate-Palmolive (NYSE:CL) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 4.6% year on year to $5.37 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.97 per share was 4.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
